record.question: Which of the following measures is NOT used to avoid cavitation in water turbines?
options: Keeping the turbine runner set as close to the tailwater level as possible
Operating the turbine at very high partial loads or beyond maximum capacity
Using cavitation-resistant materials like stainless steel or bronze on the blades
Using a properly designed draft tube to gradually recover the kinetic energy of the exhaust water
